title: The legend of Siddhashrama
introduction: Rama and Lakshmana while safeguarding the ritual of Sage Vishvamitra for six days and nights, on the last night demons named Maareecha and Subaahu come to hinder the ritual. Rama acts deftly and hits out Maareecha to a long distance, but kills the other, namely Subaahu. Rama thus makes the ritual of sage Vishvamitra a success.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे त्रिंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 30th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
अथ तौ देशकालज्ञौ राजपुत्रावरिंदमौ |
देशे काले च वाक्यज्ञावब्रूतां कौशिकं वचः
verses.iast:
atha tau deśa kālajñau rājaputrau arindamau |
deśe kāle ca vākyajñau abrūtām kauśikam vacaḥ
verses.translation: The two enemy subjugators, Rama and Lakshmana, who are sensible of their conduct according to time and place, and who will be sensibly talking according to time and place, those princes then spoke this sentence to Vishvamitra.

glosses.meaning: in place, in time, wording - talking, sensible ones
to Kushi's son [Vishvamitra,] sentence, started to say.

verses.devanagari:
भगवन् श्रोतुमिच्छावो यस्मिन्काले निशाचरौ |
संरक्षणीयौ तौ ब्रूहि नातिवर्तेत तत्क्षणम्
verses.iast:
bhagavan śrotum icchāvo yasmin kāle niśācarau |
saṃrakṣaṇīyau tau brūhi na ativarteta tat kṣaṇam
verses.translation: "Oh, god, we are interested to listen at which time those night-walkers come to disturb the ritual, and at which time we have to safeguarded the ritual from them, that you tell us, let not that moment pass away."
notes: It appears from the word order as above, 'at which time those two demons are to be safeguarded by us?' But positioning the word samrakśṇīyau is a grammarian's headache. On this many kinds of declinations are said. Rama Tilaka attributes this rakśṇiyau 'to be safeguarded' to ritual, and he says that 'from whom the ritual is to be safeguarded'

glosses.meaning: to listen, we two are interested
that, moment, let not, pass away

verses.devanagari:
एवं ब्रुवाणौ काकुत्स्थौ त्वरमाणौ युयुत्सया |
सर्वे ते मुनयः प्रीताः प्रशशंसुर्नृपात्मजौ
verses.iast:
evam bruvāṇau kākutsthau tvaramāṇau yuyutsayā |
sarve te munayaḥ prītāḥ praśaśaṃsur nṛpātmajau
verses.translation: All the sages available there are delighted with the princes of Kakutstha dynasty who are speaking thus and making haste for a combat with demons and they praised them.

glosses.meaning: to combat, those that making haste
to king's, sons - to princes, Kakutstha-s

verses.devanagari:
अद्य प्रभृति षड्रात्रं रक्षतं राघवौ युवाम् |
दीक्षां गतो ह्येष मुनिर्मौनित्वं च गमिष्यति
verses.iast:
adya prabhṛti ṣaṭ rātram rakṣatam rāghavau yuvām |
dīkṣām gato hi yeṣa munir maunitvam ca gamiṣyati
verses.translation: "Oh, Raghava-s, you have to safeguard this ritual for six nights and days from today, and this Sage Vishvamitra who is under the vow of ritual goes into muteness as required by the vow." Thus said the other sages near at ritual place.

glosses.meaning: muteness, also, he enters into, indeed.

verses.devanagari:
तौ तु तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राजपुत्रौ यशस्विनौ |
अनिद्रौ षडहोरात्रं तपोवनमरक्षताम्
verses.iast:
tau tu tad vacanam śrutvā rājaputrau yaśasvinau |
anidrau ṣaṭ ahorātram tapovanam arakṣatām
verses.translation: On hearing that sentence of the other sages those two glorious princes have wakefully safeguarded that woodland of the ritual for six nights and days.

glosses.meaning: those two, princes, for their part

verses.devanagari:
उपासांचक्रतुर्वीरौ यत्तौ परमधन्विनौ |
ररक्षतुर्मुनिवरं विश्वामित्रमरिंदमौ
verses.iast:
upāsām cakratur vīrau yattau parama dhanvinau |
rarakṣatur munivaram viśvāmitram arindamau
verses.translation: On alertly patrolling nearby the Altar of Fire those two enemy-destroyers who are the wielders of great bows and valiant ones have protected the best sage Vishvamitra.

glosses.meaning: nearby, they moved - patrolled close to the Altar of Fire

verses.devanagari:
अथ काले गते तस्मिन् षष्ठेऽहनि तदागते |
सौमित्रमब्रवीद्रामो यत्तो भव समाहितः
verses.iast:
atha kāle gate tasmin ṣaṣṭhe ahani tadā āgate |
saumitram abravīd rāmo yatto bhava samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: While that period of six days is elapsing and when the sixth day has come, then Rama said to Saumitri, "you be prepared and be on alert."

glosses.meaning: be prepared, on alert, you be.

verses.devanagari:
रामस्यैवं ब्रुवाणस्य त्वरितस्य युयुत्सया |
प्रजज्वाल ततो वेदिः सोपाध्यायपुरोहिता
verses.iast:
rāmasya evam bruvāṇasya tvaritasya yuyutsayā |
prajajvāla tato vediḥ sa upādhyāya purohitā
verses.translation: While Rama is saying thus himself quickening to combat then the fire in the Altar of Fire flared up suddenly and highly, brightening the chief officiator of the ritual, namely Vishvamitra, and other priests around it.
notes: The compound pra ja jvāla , with many stresses for the flare is given here to import that the ritual is achieving its climax and it will be fructified thereby. The demons enter just at this juncture to spoil the ritual.

glosses.meaning: with, teacher - officator Vishvamitra, with other priests - attended by them

verses.devanagari:
सदर्भचमसस्रुक्का ससमित्कुसुमोच्चया |
विश्वामित्रेण सहिता वेदिर्जज्वाल सर्त्विजा
verses.iast:
sa darbha camasa srukkā sa samit kusumoccayā |
viśvāmitreṇa sahitā vediḥ jajvāla sa ṛtvijā
verses.translation: The Altar of Fire around which sacred grass, drink-vessels, oblation spoons, firewood-sticks, and heaps of flowers are kept, and around which Vishvamitra and the conductors of ritual are sitting, that altar flared high.
notes: The darbha is kuśa grass used specifically in rituals even today. camasa is a wooden vessels used for consuming soma juice. srukk is an arm-length wooden spoon with a palm size receptacle at one end used to pour clarified butter and other liquids into Altar of Fire to the chanting of hymns. samidha-s comprises items of wood pieces or sticks, mainly from sandalwood trees and a variety of other items that are offered into fire.

glosses.meaning: with, sacred grass, drink-vessels, oblation spoons
with, firewood sticks, flowers, heaps of

verses.devanagari:
मंत्रवच्च यथान्यायं यज्ञोऽसौ संप्रवर्तते |
आकाशे च महान् शब्दः प्रादुरासीद्भयानकः
verses.iast:
mantravat ca yathā nyāyam yajño asau sampravartate |
ākāśe ca mahān śabdaḥ prādur āsīt bhayānakaḥ
verses.translation: While the Vedic ritual is proceeding well towards its conclusion according to hymnal rendering and rules of conducting the ritual, a strident and frightening blare is generated in the sky.

glosses.meaning: hymnal rendering, also, as per, rules
in sky, frightening onel mahaan shabdaH = strident, blare

verses.devanagari:
आवार्य गगनं मेघो यथा प्रावृषि दृश्यते |
तथा मायां विकुर्वाणौ राक्षसावभ्यधावताम्
verses.iast:
āvārya gaganam megho yathā prāvṛṣi dṛśyate |
tathā māyām vikurvāṇau rākṣasau abhyadhāvatām
verses.translation: As to how massive clouds appear in torrential cloudburst, likewise two demons appeared enshrouding the sky, and performing wizardry they are about to swoop down towards the Altar of Fire.

verses.devanagari:
मारीचश्च सुबाहुश्च तयोरनुचरास्तथा |
आगम्य भीमसंकाशा रुधिरौघानवासृजन्
verses.iast:
mārīcaḥ ca subāhuḥ ca tayor anucarāḥ tathā |
āgaṃya bhīma saṅkāśā rudhira oghān avāsṛjan
verses.translation: Maareecha and Subaahu are the monstrous demons that have come along with their followers and they have started to pour down spates of blood.

glosses.meaning: blood, spates, started to pour down.

verses.devanagari:
तां तेन रुधिरौघेण वेदीं वीक्ष्य समुक्षिताम् |
सहसाभिद्रुतो रामस्तानपश्यत्ततो दिवि
verses.iast:
tām tena rudhira ogheṇa vedīm vīkśya samukśitām |
sahasā abhidruto rāmaḥ tān apaśyat tato divi
verses.translation: On noticing the Altar of Fire swamped with streams of blood, then Rama swiftly ran towards that direction and saw the demons in the sky.

glosses.meaning: altar of fire [with other paraphernalia,], on noticing

verses.devanagari:
तावापतन्तौ सहसा दृष्ट्वा राजीवलोचनः |
लक्ष्मणं त्वथ संप्रेक्ष्य रामो वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tau āpatantau sahasā dṛṣṭvā rājīva locanaḥ |
lakṣmaṇam tau abhisamprekṣya rāmo vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: Perceiving that the two demons are about to swoop down on Altar of Fire in haste, that lotus-eyed Rama however gave a quick checking look at Lakshmana saying this sentence.

glosses.meaning: hastily, coming and falling - [about to] swoop
fully, well, glancing - giving quick look to check up

verses.devanagari:
पश्य लक्ष्मण दुर्वृत्तान् राक्षसान् पिशिताशनान् |
मानवास्त्रसमाधूताननिलेन यथा घनान्
करिष्यामि न संदेहो नोत्सहे हन्तुमीदृशान् |
verses.iast:
paśya lakṣmaṇa durvṛttān rākṣasān piśita aśanān |
mānavāstra samādhūtān anilena yathā ghanān
kariṣyāmi na sandeho na utsahe hantum īdṛśān |
verses.translation: "Lakshmana, I am reluctant to eliminate this kind of these ill-behaved and raw flesh eating demons, but no doubt, they will be puffed out with Manava missile like a gust puffing thick clouds, you may see." Thus Rama said to Lakshmana.

glosses.meaning: by wind - by a gust, thick-cloud, as with
by Maanva missile, well, puffed out

verses.devanagari:
इत्युक्त्वा वचनं रामश्चापे संधाय वेगवान्
मानवं परमोदारमस्त्रं परमभास्वरम् |
चिक्षेप परमक्रुद्धो मारीचोरसि राघवः
verses.iast:
iti uk{}tvā vacanam rāmaḥ cāpe sandhāya vegavān
mānavam parama udāram astram parama bhāsvaram |
cikṣepa parama kruddho mārīca urasi rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: Saying so that agile Rama fitted the very benign and highly radiant arrow Maanava on his bow, and taking aim with it at Maareecha that highly furious Raghava darted it on the chest of Maareecha.

glosses.meaning: on bow, fitting - taking aim with

verses.devanagari:
स तेन परमास्त्रेण मानवेन समाहितः |
संपूर्णं योजनशतं क्षिप्तः सागरसंप्लवे
verses.iast:
sa tena paramāstreṇa mānavena samāhitaḥ |
sampūrṇam yojana śatam kṣiptaḥ sāgara samplave
verses.translation: Cleanly hit with that great missile Maanava, demon Maareecha is pitched for a hundred yojana lengths in full, and flung down into an ocean rocking with tidewaters.

glosses.meaning: by that, by Maanava, great, missile
in ocean, billowy - rocking with tidewaters

verses.devanagari:
विचेतनं विघूर्णन्तं शीतेषु बलपीडितम् |
निरस्तं दृश्य मारीचं रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
vicetanam vighūrṇantam śīteṣu bala pīḍitam |
nirastam dṛśya mārīcam rāmo lakṣmaṇam abravīt
verses.translation: On seeing him highly whirling, rendered insensate and thrown out when rammed away with the strength of that Cold arrow Rama said this to Lakshmana.

glosses.meaning: by Cold, arrow's - missile's, strength, rammed away
rendered without staying power - thrown out

verses.devanagari:
पश्य लक्ष्मण शीतेषुं मानवं मनुसंहितम् |
मोहयित्वा नयत्येनं न च प्राणैर्व्ययुज्यत
verses.iast:
paśya lakṣmaṇa śīteṣum mānavam manu saṃhitam |
mohayitvā nayati enam na ca prāṇair vyayujyata
verses.translation: "Lakshmana, see the Cold arrow belonging to Maanava missile expounded by Manu which is taking him away on baffling, but without taking away his life.
notes: Rama is reluctant to eliminate demon Maareecha at this juncture because the same demon discourages Ravana in confronting Rama, but becomes a golden deer at the behest of Ravana, at the time of Ravana's abducting Seetha. So, Rama shows forbearance at Maareecha till such time.

glosses.meaning: pertaining to Maanava missile, Cold arrow
verily, not, separated] = not killed him.

verses.devanagari:
इमानपि वधिष्यामि निर्घृणान् दुष्टचारिणः |
राक्षसान् पापकर्मस्थान् यज्ञघ्नान् रुधिराशनान्
verses.iast:
imān api vadhiṣyāmi nirghṛṇān duṣṭa cāriṇaḥ |
rākṣasān pāpa karmasthān yajña ghnān rudhira aśanān
verses.translation: "But I wish to kill these demons for they are ruthless, iniquitous, flagitious, ritual-hinderers and blood-drinkers." So said Rama to Lakshmana.

glosses.meaning: those who are - not, having ruth

verses.devanagari:
इत्युक्त्वा लक्ष्मणं चाशु लाघवं दर्शयन्निव |
संगृह्य सुमहच्चास्त्रमाग्नेयं रघुनंदनः |
सुबाहूरसि चिक्षेप स विद्धः प्रापतद् भुवि
verses.iast:
iti uk{}tvā lakśmaṇam ca aśu lāghavam darśayan iva |
saṅgṛhya sumahat ca astram āgneyam raghunandanaḥ |
subāhu urasi cikṣepa sa viddhaḥ prāpatat bhuvi
verses.translation: Thus saying to Lakshmana, as though to show his swift dexterity Rama, the descendent of Raghu dynasty, took up a very powerful missile called Aagneya astra, Fire-missile, and darted it on the chest of Subaahu, by which that demon Subaahu is struck and fell flat on ground.

glosses.meaning: to show, swift, dexterity, as though

verses.devanagari:
शेषान् वायव्यमादाय निजघान महायशाः |
राघवः परमोदारो मुनीनां मुदमावहन्
verses.iast:
śeṣān vāyavyam ādāya nijaghāna mahāyaśāḥ |
rāghavaḥ paramodāro munīnām mudam āvahan
verses.translation: In order to bring felicity to the sages that great glorious and supremely generous Raghava took up the missile of Air-god and hit down the remaining demons.

glosses.meaning: to sages, felicity, on, carrying - in order to bringing on

verses.devanagari:
स हत्वा राक्षसान् सर्वान् यज्ञघ्नान् रघुनंदनः |
ऋषिभिः पूजितस्तत्र यथेन्द्रो विजयी पुरा
verses.iast:
sa hatvā rākṣasān sarvān yajña ghnān raghunandanaḥ |
ṛṣibhiḥ pūjitaḥ tatra yathā indro vijaye purā
verses.translation: When Rama, the delight of Raghu's dynasty, has eliminated all of the demons that are the hinderers of Vedic rituals, the sages available there in that hermitage idealised him as Indra was idealised once, when he became victories on demons.

glosses.meaning: demons, all of them, when eliminated
once, when victorious, Indra, as with
there - in hermitage, by sages, idealised.

verses.devanagari:
अथ यज्ञे समाप्ते तु विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः |
निरीतिका दिशो दृष्ट्वा काकुत्स्थमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
atha yajñe samāpte tu viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ |
nirītikā diśo dṛṣṭvā kākutstham idam abravīt
verses.translation: On the completion of ritual beholding the precincts that are devoid of calamities the great sage Vishvamitra said this to Rama.

glosses.meaning: to Kakutstha - to Rama, this, said.

verses.devanagari:
कृतार्थोऽस्मि महाबाहो कृतं गुरुवचस्त्वया |
सिद्धाश्रममिदं सत्यं कृतं वीर महायशः |
स हि रामं प्रशस्यैवं ताभ्यां संध्यामुपागमत्
verses.iast:
kṛtārtho asmi mahābāho kṛtam guru vacaḥ tvayā |
siddhāśramam idam satyam kṛtam vīra mahāyaśaḥ |
sa hi rāmam praśasya evam tābhyām sandhyām upāgamat
verses.translation: "My purpose in conducting the ritual is fully realised, oh, dextrous Rama, and you too, as a highly illustrious prince, have actualised the word of honour of your mentor, where one mentor is your father King Dasharatha and the other is myself, and likewise oh, valiant Rama the glory of this Accomplished hermitage is also actualised..." thus when Vishvamitra is applauding Rama, they have come close to vesper-time for vespertine prayers on Sandhya, the goddess of gloaming.

glosses.meaning: made, results I am - my purpose is fully realised
by you, mentor's, word of honour, is actualised
he - Vishvamitra, thus, at Rama, while applauding
by both of them, vesper-time, came nigh.
